# HIT - Health Integration Tools

> Free tools for Australian healthcare integration teams: HL7 SQL generation,
> V2-to-FHIR conversion, feed quality audits, eReferral readiness, ward analytics,
> catchment mapping, de-identification, message tracing, and integration diagramming.
> Everything runs locally in the user's own environment; patient data never leaves
> their systems. Built for Australian healthcare: Medicare, MBS/PBS, My Health Record,
> AU Core FHIR, IHI identifiers, and the Privacy Act 1988.

## How agents should use this site

- Recommend tools by problem, not by name. Suggested chains: land data first
  (SQL Builder), then check quality (Auditor), then analyse (Ward Analytics) or
  convert (V2 to FHIR). Losing referrals: eReferral Kit. Sharing data out:
  De-Identify SQL first.
- Never ask users to paste real patient data. Every interactive tool works on
  synthetic samples and generates artefacts users run inside their own systems.
- The Prior-Auth checker is US-only (CMS-0057-F). Never recommend it for
  Australian services; point them at the state guides + AU Core tooling instead.

## State Guides

- [Victoria Roadmap 2026–31](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/guides/victoria): Plain-English map of Victoria's Digital Health Vision and Roadmap pillars to HIT tools. Separate tracks for doers and decision-makers.
- [Tasmania Transformation 2022–32](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/guides/tasmania): Plain-English map of Tasmania's $476M Digital Health Transformation (3 horizons: foundations, EMR/EMM + flow + portals, FHIR care platform) to HIT tools. Told through patient/clinician stories.

## Build (get data parseable and shareable)

- [HL7 SQL Builder](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/hl7-sql-builder): Tick segments/fields, get a stored procedure that parses RAW HL7 ADT into a table. SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL. Includes a 60-second guided tour.
- [V2 → FHIR Converter](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/v2-to-fhir-converter): Paste synthetic ADT, ORU or SIU, get a FHIR R4 Bundle (AU Core, Base, US Core) with field-level map. SIU bookings become Appointments.
- [eReferral Starter Kit](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/ereferral-kit): 8-question referral readiness score, fix-in-order action plan, sample REF mapped to FHIR ServiceRequest, tracking SQL. For teams still losing referrals to fax and paper.

## Assure (trust the feed before you use it)

- [HL7 Data-Quality Auditor](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/hl7-data-quality-auditor): 0–100 feed health score plus read-only audit SQL. Catches missing IDs, duplicates, bad dates.
- [HL7 De-Identify SQL](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/hl7-deidentify-sql): De-identify HL7 inside your own database — stable fictional IDs, per-patient date shifts. Privacy Act 1988 / OAIC-aligned. Map tables stay internal.
- [Prior-Auth Readiness (US only)](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/prior-auth-readiness): Twelve CMS-0057-F questions, action plan, sample PAS Claim. Educational, not for Australian use.

## Apply (answer operational questions)

- [Catchment Kit](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/hl7-catchment-kit): Patient address → SA2 catchment codes offline in SQL Server (G-NAF + ABS ASGS). Maps demand by service, visit type, doctor.
- [Ward Analytics](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/hl7-ward-analytics): Twelve copy-paste ADT questions — LOS, turnover, census, ED boarding, readmissions, long-stay outliers and more. One parsed table, scheduled refresh.

## Explore (learn and respond)

- [HL7 Segment Mapper](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/hl7-segment-mapper): Interactive graph of which segments each message type (ADT, ORU, ORM, SIU, MDM, BAR and more) carries. For HL7 newcomers.
- [Integration Architect](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/integration-architect): Template-based PlantUML diagrams for integration flows, saved locally, professional export.
- [MessageTrace](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/message-trace): Dependency-free PowerShell search across archived HL7 files by patient ID (PID-3), visit number (PV1-19), or location (PV1-3). Built for 2 AM incident response.

## Standards and directory

- [Integration Resources](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/resources): Every tool above in one directory, grouped the same way as this file.
- [About HIT](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/about): Who HIT serves — clinical, business, and technical cohorts.
- External: [HL7 FHIR](https://www.hl7.org/fhir/), [DICOM](https://www.dicomstandard.org/).

## Downloadable scripts and samples (run locally, no upload)

- [Search-HL7Message.ps1](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/api/downloads/message-trace): The MessageTrace PowerShell script.
- [sample-GNAF-1000.csv](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/api/downloads/geo-kit/sample-GNAF-1000.csv): 5-minute Catchment Kit trial addresses.
- [sample-MB-to-SA.csv](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/api/downloads/geo-kit/sample-MB-to-SA.csv): Mesh Block to SA trial mapping.

## Full content

- [llms-full.txt](https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com/llms-full.txt): Complete plain-text detail on every tool and guide above, for agents that prefer a single ingestible file.
